about_the_game:
Gambetto combines roguelike deckbuilding and the rules of chess to create a challenging, turn-based strategy card game.

Big-Brain Combat!

Confront adversaries on a 5x5 chess board, and leverage your wit with careful placements, timed movements, and varied card synergies. Claim your foe’s king to win the round and dramatically improve your deck with hundreds of randomized rewards!

Improve Your Deck!

Encounter hidden shops and unlock rewards to add powerful cards to your deck. Each king has a unique, character-based card pool, further enhanced with other card effects and synergies. Craft the strongest deck with your imagination and creativity. Endless possibilities await!

... And much much more!!!

Gambetto is still under development, and upcoming features include: 

  • Complete runs or finish special achievements to unlock new cards and terrific factions. 

  • Discover puzzling challenges with difficulty modifiers for the boldest, smartest challengers.

  • Difficulty modifiers that are prepared for the boldest, smartest challengers.
